caption:
"Just a second." "Close it behind you." The cold stopped coming in the moment the door clicked.

A door left open for one second lets the whole hallway cool, and closing it takes less than that.

For whoever closes the door behind them, even for a second.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A hallway with a cream door standing open on the right with warm light in it and pale blue streaks of cold air blowing left into the room. A plum block figure with narrowed eyes in the middle says just a second. A ink-black block figure with white eyes at the left answers close it behind you, and the plum one walks to the door and swings it shut, and the streaks vanish. It says ...warmer already. Both end with happy eyes. The text stays: me closing it behind me.
